conventions: hosts list each edge once as (u, v) with u < v
statements quantify over all pair sets, loops and reversed pairs included

modules.name: GTDefs
modules.source:
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset

namespace GT

/-- Edge sets: ordered pairs (u, v), read as the edge {u, v}. Hosts list each edge once, with u < v. -/
abbrev Edges := Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

/-- No three edges (a, b), (b, c), (a, c). -/
def TriangleFree (S : Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, ¬ (e.1 = g.1 ∧ e.2 = f.1 ∧ f.2 = g.2)

instance (S : Edges) : Decidable (TriangleFree S) := by
  unfold TriangleFree; infer_instance

end GT

modules.name: G4Defs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace G4

/-- Domain contract (c4_host_v2): u and v are joined in S, in either orientation. -/
def adj (S : GT.Edges) (u v : ℕ) : Prop := (u, v) ∈ S ∨ (v, u) ∈ S

instance (S : GT.Edges) (u v : ℕ) : Decidable (adj S u v) := by
  unfold adj; infer_instance

def verts (S : GT.Edges) : Finset ℕ := S.image Prod.fst ∪ S.image Prod.snd

/-- No 4-cycle a-b-c-d-a with a ≠ c and b ≠ d. -/
def C4Free (S : GT.Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ verts S, ∀ b ∈ verts S, ∀ c ∈ verts S, ∀ d ∈ verts S,
    a ≠ c → b ≠ d → ¬ (adj S a b ∧ adj S b c ∧ adj S c d ∧ adj S d a)

instance (S : GT.Edges) : Decidable (C4Free S) := by
  unfold C4Free; infer_instance

end G4

modules.name: RPDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace RP

/-- Generated representation `cross_2`: edges whose endpoints lie in different classes. -/
def cross_2 (c : ℕ → Fin 2) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => c e.1 ≠ c e.2

/-- Generated representation `cross_3`: edges whose endpoints lie in different classes. -/
def cross_3 (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => c e.1 ≠ c e.2

/-- Generated representation `inside_2`: edges inside a class. -/
def inside_2 (c : ℕ → Fin 2) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => c e.1 = c e.2

/-- Generated representation `inside_3`: edges inside a class. -/
def inside_3 (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => c e.1 = c e.2

/-- Generated representation `ordered_2`: edges from a lower class to a higher class (by the host orientation u < v). -/
def ordered_2 (c : ℕ → Fin 2) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => c e.1 < c e.2

/-- Generated representation `ordered_3`: edges from a lower class to a higher class (by the host orientation u < v). -/
def ordered_3 (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => c e.1 < c e.2

/-- Generated representation `adjacent_2`: edges between consecutive classes. -/
def adjacent_2 (c : ℕ → Fin 2) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => (c e.1).val + 1 = (c e.2).val ∨ (c e.2).val + 1 = (c e.1).val

/-- Generated representation `adjacent_3`: edges between consecutive classes. -/
def adjacent_3 (c : ℕ → Fin 3) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter fun e => (c e.1).val + 1 = (c e.2).val ∨ (c e.2).val + 1 = (c e.1).val

end RP

import GTDefs
import G4Defs
import RPDefs
import RPConj
import RPP1
namespace RPP2
theorem proof : RPConj.cross_2_sound_tf := by
  unfold RPConj.cross_2_sound_tf
  intro c H
  unfold GT.TriangleFree RP.cross_2
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ he ⟨b', d⟩ hf ⟨a', d'⟩ hg ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at he hf hg
  simp only at h1 h2 h3
  subst h1 h2 h3
  omega
end RPP2
